"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from datetime import datetime

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))


def refund_shipping(payment, amount, at: datetime, *, idempotency_key=None):
    """Refund (part of) the shipping fee of a captured payment.

    The refund is added to ``payment.refunded_amount`` and the payment is
    marked ``"refunded"`` once the full captured amount has been refunded.
    """
    # Idempotency must be checked before any state validation so that retries
    # succeed even after the payment's status has changed.
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("shipping_refunded"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return entry["payment"]

    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))

    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")

    captured = round_money(payment.amount)
    refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > captured:
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))

    payment.refunded_amount = refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount >= captured:
        payment.status = "refunded"

    audit.record(
        "shipping_refunded",
        payment=payment,
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        refunded_amount=payment.refunded_amount,
        at=ensure_utc(at),
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
    )
    return payment
EOF

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.adjustments import refund_shipping
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
T0=datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(): return Payment("p","i",Decimal("100.00"),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)
p=mk(); refund_shipping(p,Decimal("40.00"),T0); assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("40.00") and p.status=="captured"
refund_shipping(p,Decimal("60.00"),T0); assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00") and p.status=="refunded"
for bad in [Decimal("0"),Decimal("-1")]:
    try: refund_shipping(mk(),bad,T0); raise SystemExit("no err")
    except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="non_positive_amount"
try: refund_shipping(mk(),Decimal("101"),T0); raise SystemExit("no err")
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="refund_exceeds_captured"
try: refund_shipping(Payment("p","i",Decimal("10"),status="authorized"),Decimal("1"),T0); raise SystemExit("no err")
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="invalid_state"
# idempotency retry after full refund
audit.clear(); p=mk(); r1=refund_shipping(p,Decimal("100.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
r2=refund_shipping(p,Decimal("100.00"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is r2 and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00")
# bool rejected by to_money
try: refund_shipping(mk(),True,T0); raise SystemExit("no err")
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="float_amount"
print("all edge checks passed")
'
